verdict.rationale: Bento lets you write alerts in plain English. Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook, and fires are grouped into incidents and triaged as real or benign. It also tracks cost per run, tool failure rates, and release scoring, which these alerts could plausibly target. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of alerts on cost spikes and eval-score drops, in-depth alert-configuration docs beyond marketing/FAQ pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
